title: Civilization VII studio Firaxis cuts about 60 jobs
subject: civilization7
description:
What should Firaxis make next? 👇

Firaxis Games, the studio behind Civilization VII and XCOM, has reportedly laid off about 60 people, roughly a third of its staff, according to Bloomberg. 2K confirmed studio head Heather Hazen is stepping down.

Sources: Bloomberg via PC Gamer (Nov 17, 2026)
Game footage © 2K / Firaxis Games.

scenes.text: Civilization studio Firaxis has reportedly laid off about 60 people.
Bloomberg reported the cuts on November 17. That's roughly a third of the studio.
2K confirmed studio head Heather Hazen is stepping down after more than 25 years at Firaxis.
2K said the team is being reduced to focus on design, technology and the player experience.
Bloomberg also says a new XCOM game missed a major milestone this year.
Civilization VII came out in 2025 and still sits at Mixed in Steam user reviews.
